title: Somnigroup Announces Second Quarter Cash Dividend
summary: Somnigroup International Inc. (NYSE: SGI, "Company" or "Somnigroup") today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a second quarter cash dividend on its common stock of $0.17 per share. The dividend is payable on June 4, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 21, 2026. About Somnigroup International Inc. Somnigroup is the world's leading bedding company, dedicated to transforming how the world sleeps. With superior capabilities in design, manufacturing, distribution and retail, we deliver breakthrough sleep solutions and serve the evolving needs of consumers in more than 100 countries worldwide, through our fully-owned businesses, Tempur Sealy, Mattress Firm and Dreams.
